zh: 动物与农耕改进、分支合并及更新 #51
en: Animal and Farm Improvements, Branch Merge and Update #51
ja: 動物と農場の改善、ブランチの統合とアップデート #51

contents.DefaultText:
Hello everyone!
Time for a new update.

First. Today we're updating the main branch to the latest version before we introduced the new animal system. We will be merging the new system a bit later, once it has become more stable and balanced.

This will be the last update before the holidays, so we would like to take the opportunity to wish you all a merry Christmas and a Happy New Year! :)



Now, to the new content:

<size=150%>Animal Improvements:</size>We've made many improvements to animals and there are still more coming. We will be tweaking all these new features over the following weeks. So let us know if you have any feedback or find any bugs we may have missed! :)


<size=125%>Navigation:</size>Animals can finally no longer magically climb cliffs. Not even when fleeing!

<size=125%>Traps:</size>The old trap system is no longer active for the animal npcs. Animals will now fully interact with traps on their own and will have a chance to trigger them based on the type of trap, your trapping skill and their own cunning. Also, wolf packs can again interact with traps and lose some of their wolves to them.

<size=125%>Food:</size>Animals are now able to eat food from the ground if they're hungry. So be careful with leaving things on the ground.
Shy animals like hares or deer will generally avoid it unless they're very hungry, but more aggressive animals, like wolves, bears and boars, will usually don't mind you being around. They will not eat your food while you're there, but they will get progressively more angry if you don't leave.

<size=125%>Smell:</size>Some animals have a good sense of smell and can detect food from afar. This can be a problem, but can also be used to your advantage. At the moment this only works for smellier food items, such as meat, and doesn't work for vegetables. Boars and bears have a particularly good sense of smell, and the latter are specially dangerous since they can even open inventories and eat the food from inside.

<size=125%>Crops:</size>Some animals are now able to eat from gardens and fields; damaging your plants.
Boars can be quite dangerous for your crops so plan accordingly. At the moment, the best way to deal with them is to have you crops near home so you can hear the boar approaching and attack him before he causes any damage, or alternatively, setting enough traps in the area that he'll eat from them instead and hopefully get killed.



<size=150%>Farming Improvements:</size>
<size=125%>Levee:</size>This new location improvement is a difficult to build but will protect an area from floods, making it more viable for long term settlement. It slowly degrades over time, so it also requires a bit of maintenance.

<size=125%>Wheat:</size>A new grain crop that can be bought from the trader. As a crop it's a lot more delicate than rye and consumes and requires a lot of nutrients, while also growing faster and being tastier. 
It will produce the most yield if planted during spring on fertile soil.
Its grain can of course be use to make all bread products as well as ale and syrup.

<size=125%>Thresher:</size>A new, relatively simple tool that makes the process of threshing rye and wheat faster.

<size=125%>Sickle:</size>A new metal tool that can be used to harvest plants at a faster speed.

<size=125%>Scythe:</size>Another new metal tool that can be used to harvest plants faster and more efficiently (lower stamina cost). This tool however can only be used in fields and not in gardens.

<size=125%>Metal Hoe:</size>As the flint hoe, but with much greater durability.

<size=125%>Field Improvements:</size>Fields now have double the yield, but double the harvest steps.

<size=125%>Garden Improvements:</size>Garden plots now lose acidity and nutrients a lot slower, making them easier to maintain.
Fertilizer now adds half as much nutrients, making it more practical and usable. It is also easier to make, as excrement and rotten remains now give twice as much value in the compost bin.
There is now also a new special action in gardens that allows you to "reset" the soil; restoring its default nutrients, acidity and hydration, at the cost of damaging its plants.


That's all the main new features for this update.
And here are the patch notes:


<size=150%>Version EA_0.56 and hotfixes since the last Patch Notes:</size>
- Traps now work with the animal npcs.
- Animals can now eat food items.
- Animals can now interact with crops.
- Bears can now interact with inventories.
- Added new farming tools (thresher, sickle, scythe, metal hoe).
- Added Levee improvement.
- Balancing tweaks to garden plots and fields.
- Added wheat and all of its derivatives.
- Tweaked the sanctuary values of some furniture and improvements.
- Bears will more frequently visit regions that have in-season berries.
- Animals spawning rates have been made slower.
- Hunting Spear now requires a metal spear before it can be researched.
- Fixed a bug which allowed players to skate on Frozen Water without Skates.
- Fixed a bug which caused medium or high snow to affect the Skate action.
- Being tired no longer hides the Southern Rapids dive into Green Falls action.
- Boiling durability is now hidden if its 0.
- Pond now has proper Winter art.
- Cutting down large trees now costs a bit more stamina.
- Pyre now burns through its fuel faster than before.
- Fixed a bug where saving and loading a game while having items in inventory blueprints such as Crucible would move items between slots or mess with their durabiities and type.
- Sledges can now be repaired using twine.
- Fixed a bug which prevented Springberries and Billberries from being placeable in Unsealed Fermentation Bin.
- Removed the Partridge Enchantment Blueprint from Duck Carcass.

- It is no longer possible to move items and liquids in and out of sealed Fermentation bins.
- Animals now get tired a bit faster when running away from the player.
- Frost Shrine now melts on temperatures above 0.
- Removed enchantment recipe from skinned squirrels.
- Fixed a bug which prevented metal skinning knife from being used in blueprints requiring a cutting tool.
- Fixed the art for Hare Urge.
- Fixed a glitch where a rustic barrel would permanently stay heated up.
- Dry needles are now considered bedding material and improvised bed can be made from them.
- Campfire, Rain, Frostleaf and Garlic now offer some mosquito protection.
- Fixed some typos and incorrect texts.
- Added description for Cattail Fluff.
- Ongoing saves which started outside of River Clearing should no longer get stuck when you enter River Clearing.
- Infection statuses are now visible and pinable inside the Internal Status Page.
- Rustic Barrels can no longer hold liquids and solids at the same time.
- Fixed a bug where the will o' wisp even would appear when you entered the river clearing if you had started from a different location. 
- Mortar and Pestle can now crush edible acorns into flour.
- Fixed a bug that was causing the death of bears to affect other animals.
- Fixed a bug that was causing the animals (including the bear) not to die properly when poisoned.
- Fixed a bug that was causing the wolf to be too aggressive.
- Nesting Box can now be picked up and placed down. (if your partridge are not laying eggs, trying picking the box up and placing it again)
- New areas now have proper icons for the Parchment Map.
- Fixed a bug where carcasses would get eaten by wolves from the player's hands.
- Ducks and Partridges eaten by predators no longer drop hooks and needles but bone pieces instead.
- Hardtack now lasts a lot longer before spoiling
- Intermediate hunting now unlocks when both basic hunting and basic survival are completed.
- Dried nettle leaves now have a trade value.
- Fixed the weight of unfired storage pot and cauldron.
- Frost Shrine Blueprint now properly spends the water used.
- Fixed an issue where animals couldn't be attacked.
- Fixed a bug which caused nightvision to persist after moon blessing.
- Warming up by the Furnace no longer triggers fire spirit Summoning.
- Updated Chinese translation.
- Fixed duplicate texts in Chinese, Korean and Japanese.
- Hopefully fixed an issue with starting older save files on modded version of the games.
- Wolves will now get angry if you spend too much time in an area with them.
- Added starting resources to new starting locations.
- Sharpened stone can now be made in the Dark.
- Squirrel Carcass can no longer be eaten or cooked it needs to be butchered first.
- Fixed a bug which allowed the player to butcher the piglet carcass more than once.
- Fixed a combat window bug that would get the game stuck.



That's all for now.
See you all in 2026!

Reminder: All fixes and new content are added to the public beta branch first.
If you want to access them you can find the instructions on the link below. Be warned though, things are less stable there and are likely to undergo balance changes quite frequently! :)

contents.Text:
大家好！

又到了更新时间。

首先，今天我们将主分支更新到了引入新版动物系统之前的最新版本。待新系统更加稳定平衡后，我们会将其合并到主分支。

这是假期前的最后一次更新，所以我们想借此机会，祝大家圣诞快乐，新年快乐！:)

现在，来看看新内容：

<size=150%>动物改进：</size>我们对动物进行了许多改进，而且还有更多改进即将推出。接下来的几周内，我们将对所有的这些新功能进行调整。如果您有任何反馈或发现任何我们可能遗漏的错误，请告诉我们！:)

<size=125%>导航：</size>动物终于不能再神秘地爬上悬崖了。即使是逃跑的时候也不能！

<size=125%>陷阱：</size>旧的陷阱系统已不再对动物NPC生效。现在，动物会主动与陷阱互动，并根据陷阱类型、你的捕猎技能以及它们自身的狡猾程度来概率触发陷阱。此外，狼群也可能会多次与陷阱互动，导致一部分狼折损其中。

<size=125%>食物：</size>动物现在饥饿时会从地上捡食食物。因此请小心放在地上的食物。

像野兔或鹿这样胆小的动物通常会避开地上的食物，除非它们非常饿；但像狼、熊和野猪这样更具攻击性的动物通常不会介意你在附近。它们不会在你待在那里的时候吃掉你的食物，但如果你不离开，它们会变得越来越生气。

<size=125%>嗅觉：</size>有些动物嗅觉灵敏，可以从远处嗅到食物。这可能带来麻烦，但也可以转化为优势。目前，这种方法只对气味较重的食物有效，例如肉类，对蔬菜无效。野猪和熊的嗅觉尤其灵敏，后者尤其危险，因为它甚至可以打开物品栏，吃掉里面的食物。

<size=125%>农作物：</size>现在有些动物会啃食菜园和农田里的作物，造成损害。

野猪对农作物危害很大，所以要做好相应的准备。目前，最好的办法是把农作物种在离家近的地方，这样你就能听到野猪靠近的声音，并在它造成损害之前攻击它；或者，你也可以在附近设置足够的陷阱，让野猪去吃陷阱里的食物，希望它能被陷阱杀死。

<size=150%>农业改良：</size>

<size=125%>堤坝：</size>这项新的农业改良设施建造起来比较困难，但可以保护一片区域免受洪水侵袭，使其更适合长期定居。它会随着时间推移缓慢损耗，因此也需要一些维护。

<size=125%>小麦：</size>一种可以从商人处购买的新型谷物作物。它比黑麦更娇嫩，是一种需要消耗和吸收大量养分的作物，但生长速度更快，味道也更鲜美。

在春季播种于肥沃的土壤中产量最高。

小麦的麦粒也理所应当的可以用来制作各种面包制品、麦芽酒和糖浆。

<size=125%>脱粒机：</size>一种新型的、相对简单的工具，可以加快黑麦和小麦的脱粒速度。

<size=125%>镰刀：</size>一种新的金属工具，可以用来更快地收割作物。

<size=125%>长柄镰：</size>另一种新的金属工具，可以用来更快、更高效地收割作物（消耗的体力更少）。然而，此工具只能在田地中使用，不能在菜园中使用。

<size=125%>金属锄：</size>与燧石锄类似，但更加耐用。

<size=125%>田地改良：</size>田地产量翻倍，但收割次数也翻倍。

<size=125%>菜园改良：</size>菜园的酸度和养分流失速度大幅降低，更易于维护。

肥料的养分减半，更加实用。肥料的制作也更加便捷，粪便和腐烂物在堆肥箱中的价值翻倍。

菜园中新增了一项特殊操作，可以“重置”土壤；恢复土壤的默认养分、酸度和水分，但会伤害植株。

以上就是本次更新的主要新增功能。

以下是更新说明：

<size=150%>版本 EA_0.56 及自上次更新以来的热修复：</size>

- 陷阱现在会对动物NPC生效。

- 动物现在会吃掉食物。

- 动物现在会与农作物互动。

- 熊现在会与存储物互动。

- 新增农具（脱粒机、镰刀、长柄镰、金属锄）。

- 新增堤坝改良设施。

- 对菜园和农田进行了平衡性调整。

- 新增小麦及其全部的衍生物品。

- 调整了部分家具和改良设施的庇护值。

- 熊会更频繁地光顾有当季浆果的区域。

- 动物的生成速度降低。

- 狩猎长矛现在需要有金属长矛才能进行研究。

- 修复了玩家无需冰鞋即可在冰面上滑行的错误。

- 修复了中等或高积雪会影响滑冰动作的错误。

- 疲劳状态不再会隐藏从南部湍流潜入绿色瀑布的动作。

- 现在煮沸度若为0则会被隐藏。

- 池塘现在拥有正确的冬季美术效果。

- 现在砍伐大树会消耗更多体力。

- 现在仪式柴堆燃烧燃料的速度比以前更快。

- 修复了在物品栏蓝图（例如坩埚）中有物品时，保存和加载游戏会导致物品在不同槽位之间移动，或影响其耐久度和类型的错误。

- 现在可以使用细线修理雪橇。

- 修复了无法将春莓和越橘放置在未密封的发酵桶中的错误。

- 从鸭子尸体中移除了灰山鹑附魔蓝图。

- 现在无法将物品和液体移入或移出密封的发酵箱。

- 现在动物在逃离玩家时会更快的感到疲惫。

- 霜冻祭坛现在会在温度高于 0 时融化。

- 从剥皮的松鼠中移除了附魔配方。

- 修复了在需要切割工具的蓝图中无法使用金属剥皮刀的错误。

- 修复了“野兔冲动”的美术素材。

- 修复了简易木桶会一直保持加热状态的错误。

- 干松针现在被视为铺垫材料，可以用它们制作简易床。

- 营火、雨水、霜叶和大蒜现在可以提供一定的防蚊效果。

- 修复了一些拼写错误和文本错误。

- 添加了香蒲绒毛的描述。

- 从河畔林隙以外开始的存档在进入河畔林隙时不再会卡住。

- 感染状态现在可以在“身体内部”页面中显示并固定。

- 简易木桶现在不能同时存放液体和固体。

- 修复了从其他地点开始游戏后进入河畔林隙时会出现鬼火事件的错误。

- 现在研钵和研杵可以将可食用的橡子碾成面粉。

- 修复了熊的死亡会影响其他动物的错误。

- 修复了动物（包括熊）中毒后无法正常死亡的错误。

- 修复了狼过于好斗的错误。

- 现在可以拿起并放置巢盒了。（如果你的灰山鹑没有下蛋，请尝试拿起巢盒并重新放置。）

- 新区域的羊皮纸地图图标现在正确了。

- 修复了狼会从玩家手中吃掉动物尸体的错误。

- 被掠食者吃掉的鸭子和灰山鹑不再掉落骨钩和骨针，而是掉落骨头碎片。

- 硬面饼的保质期大大延长。

- 完成基础狩猎和基础生存后，即可解锁中级狩猎。

- 干荨麻叶现在有交易价值。

- 修复了未烧制的储物罐和坩埚的重量。

- 霜冻祭坛蓝图现在可以正确消耗用水。

- 修复了无法攻击动物的问题。

- 修复了月光赐福后夜视效果仍然存在的错误。

- 在熔炉旁取暖不再触发火之精魄的召唤。

- 更新了中文翻译。

- 修复了中文、韩文和日文中的重复文本。

- 希望能够修复在已安装模组版本的游戏中启动旧存档文件时出现的问题。

- 如果玩家和狼群在同一区域停留的时间过长，狼群现在会变得愤怒。

- 在新的起始地点添加了初始资源。

- 现在可以在黑暗中制作锋利的石头。

- 松鼠尸体现在无法直接食用或烹饪，必须先进行屠宰。

- 修复了玩家可以多次屠宰小猪尸体的错误。

- 修复了一个战斗窗口会导致游戏卡死的错误。

目前就这些啦。
我们2026年再见！

提醒：所有修复和新内容都会首先添加到公开测试版分支。

如果您想体验这些内容，可以点击下方链接查看相关说明。不过请注意，公开测试版的稳定性较差，并且可能会频繁进行平衡性调整！:)

[url="https://steamcommunity.com/app/2868860/discussions/0/600774299444324511/"]https://steamcommunity.com/app/2868860/discussions/0/600774299444324511/[/url]

菜园中新增了一项特殊操作，可以“重置”土壤；恢复土壤的默认养分、酸度和水分，但会伤害植株。

以上就是本次更新的主要新增功能。

以下是更新说明：

<size=150%>版本 EA_0.56 及自上次更新以来的热修复：</size>

- 陷阱现在会对动物NPC生效。

- 动物现在会吃掉食物。

- 动物现在会与农作物互动。

- 熊现在会与存储物互动。

- 新增农具（脱粒机、镰刀、长柄镰、金属锄）。

- 新增堤坝改良设施。

- 对菜园和农田进行了平衡性调整。

- 新增小麦及其全部的衍生物品。

- 调整了部分家具和改良设施的庇护值。

- 熊会更频繁地光顾有当季浆果的区域。

- 动物的生成速度降低。

- 狩猎长矛现在需要有金属长矛才能进行研究。

- 修复了玩家无需冰鞋即可在冰面上滑行的错误。

- 修复了中等或高积雪会影响滑冰动作的错误。

- 疲劳状态不再会隐藏从南部湍流潜入绿色瀑布的动作。

- 现在煮沸度若为0则会被隐藏。

- 池塘现在拥有正确的冬季美术效果。

- 现在砍伐大树会消耗更多体力。

- 现在仪式柴堆燃烧燃料的速度比以前更快。

- 修复了在物品栏蓝图（例如坩埚）中有物品时，保存和加载游戏会导致物品在不同槽位之间移动，或影响其耐久度和类型的错误。

- 现在可以使用细线修理雪橇。

- 修复了无法将春莓和越橘放置在未密封的发酵桶中的错误。

- 从鸭子尸体中移除了灰山鹑附魔蓝图。

- 现在无法将物品和液体移入或移出密封的发酵箱。

- 现在动物在逃离玩家时会更快的感到疲惫。

- 霜冻祭坛现在会在温度高于 0 时融化。

- 从剥皮的松鼠中移除了附魔配方。

- 修复了在需要切割工具的蓝图中无法使用金属剥皮刀的错误。

- 修复了“野兔冲动”的美术素材。

- 修复了简易木桶会一直保持加热状态的错误。

- 干松针现在被视为铺垫材料，可以用它们制作简易床。

- 营火、雨水、霜叶和大蒜现在可以提供一定的防蚊效果。

- 修复了一些拼写错误和文本错误。

- 添加了香蒲绒毛的描述。

- 从河畔林隙以外开始的存档在进入河畔林隙时不再会卡住。

- 感染状态现在可以在“身体内部”页面中显示并固定。

- 简易木桶现在不能同时存放液体和固体。

- 修复了从其他地点开始游戏后进入河畔林隙时会出现鬼火事件的错误。

- 现在研钵和研杵可以将可食用的橡子碾成面粉。

- 修复了熊的死亡会影响其他动物的错误。

- 修复了动物（包括熊）中毒后无法正常死亡的错误。

- 修复了狼过于好斗的错误。

- 现在可以拿起并放置巢盒了。（如果你的灰山鹑没有下蛋，请尝试拿起巢盒并重新放置。）

- 新区域的羊皮纸地图图标现在正确了。

- 修复了狼会从玩家手中吃掉动物尸体的错误。

- 被掠食者吃掉的鸭子和灰山鹑不再掉落骨钩和骨针，而是掉落骨头碎片。

- 硬面饼的保质期大大延长。

- 完成基础狩猎和基础生存后，即可解锁中级狩猎。

- 干荨麻叶现在有交易价值。

- 修复了未烧制的储物罐和坩埚的重量。

- 霜冻祭坛蓝图现在可以正确消耗用水。

- 修复了无法攻击动物的问题。

- 修复了月光赐福后夜视效果仍然存在的错误。

- 在熔炉旁取暖不再触发火之精魄的召唤。

- 更新了中文翻译。

- 修复了中文、韩文和日文中的重复文本。

- 希望能够修复在已安装模组版本的游戏中启动旧存档文件时出现的问题。

- 如果玩家和狼群在同一区域停留的时间过长，狼群现在会变得愤怒。

- 在新的起始地点添加了初始资源。

- 现在可以在黑暗中制作锋利的石头。

- 松鼠尸体现在无法直接食用或烹饪，必须先进行屠宰。

- 修复了玩家可以多次屠宰小猪尸体的错误。

- 修复了一个战斗窗口会导致游戏卡死的错误。

目前就这些啦。
我们2026年再见！

提醒：所有修复和新内容都会首先添加到公开测试版分支。

如果您想体验这些内容，可以点击下方链接查看相关说明。不过请注意，公开测试版的稳定性较差，并且可能会频繁进行平衡性调整！:)

contents.en:
Hello everyone!
Time for a new update.

First. Today we're updating the main branch to the latest version before we introduced the new animal system. We will be merging the new system a bit later, once it has become more stable and balanced.

This will be the last update before the holidays, so we would like to take the opportunity to wish you all a merry Christmas and a Happy New Year! :)



Now, to the new content:

<size=150%>Animal Improvements:</size>We've made many improvements to animals and there are still more coming. We will be tweaking all these new features over the following weeks. So let us know if you have any feedback or find any bugs we may have missed! :)


<size=125%>Navigation:</size>Animals can finally no longer magically climb cliffs. Not even when fleeing!

<size=125%>Traps:</size>The old trap system is no longer active for the animal npcs. Animals will now fully interact with traps on their own and will have a chance to trigger them based on the type of trap, your trapping skill and their own cunning. Also, wolf packs can again interact with traps and lose some of their wolves to them.

<size=125%>Food:</size>Animals are now able to eat food from the ground if they're hungry. So be careful with leaving things on the ground.
Shy animals like hares or deer will generally avoid it unless they're very hungry, but more aggressive animals, like wolves, bears and boars, will usually don't mind you being around. They will not eat your food while you're there, but they will get progressively more angry if you don't leave.

<size=125%>Smell:</size>Some animals have a good sense of smell and can detect food from afar. This can be a problem, but can also be used to your advantage. At the moment this only works for smellier food items, such as meat, and doesn't work for vegetables. Boars and bears have a particularly good sense of smell, and the latter are specially dangerous since they can even open inventories and eat the food from inside.

<size=125%>Crops:</size>Some animals are now able to eat from gardens and fields; damaging your plants.
Boars can be quite dangerous for your crops so plan accordingly. At the moment, the best way to deal with them is to have you crops near home so you can hear the boar approaching and attack him before he causes any damage, or alternatively, setting enough traps in the area that he'll eat from them instead and hopefully get killed.



<size=150%>Farming Improvements:</size>
<size=125%>Levee:</size>This new location improvement is a difficult to build but will protect an area from floods, making it more viable for long term settlement. It slowly degrades over time, so it also requires a bit of maintenance.

<size=125%>Wheat:</size>A new grain crop that can be bought from the trader. As a crop it's a lot more delicate than rye and consumes and requires a lot of nutrients, while also growing faster and being tastier. 
It will produce the most yield if planted during spring on fertile soil.
Its grain can of course be use to make all bread products as well as ale and syrup.

<size=125%>Thresher:</size>A new, relatively simple tool that makes the process of threshing rye and wheat faster.

<size=125%>Sickle:</size>A new metal tool that can be used to harvest plants at a faster speed.

<size=125%>Scythe:</size>Another new metal tool that can be used to harvest plants faster and more efficiently (lower stamina cost). This tool however can only be used in fields and not in gardens.

<size=125%>Metal Hoe:</size>As the flint hoe, but with much greater durability.

<size=125%>Field Improvements:</size>Fields now have double the yield, but double the harvest steps.

<size=125%>Garden Improvements:</size>Garden plots now lose acidity and nutrients a lot slower, making them easier to maintain.
Fertilizer now adds half as much nutrients, making it more practical and usable. It is also easier to make, as excrement and rotten remains now give twice as much value in the compost bin.
There is now also a new special action in gardens that allows you to "reset" the soil; restoring its default nutrients, acidity and hydration, at the cost of damaging its plants.


That's all the main new features for this update.
And here are the patch notes:


<size=150%>Version EA_0.56 and hotfixes since the last Patch Notes:</size>
- Traps now work with the animal npcs.
- Animals can now eat food items.
- Animals can now interact with crops.
- Bears can now interact with inventories.
- Added new farming tools (thresher, sickle, scythe, metal hoe).
- Added Levee improvement.
- Balancing tweaks to garden plots and fields.
- Added wheat and all of its derivatives.
- Tweaked the sanctuary values of some furniture and improvements.
- Bears will more frequently visit regions that have in-season berries.
- Animals spawning rates have been made slower.
- Hunting Spear now requires a metal spear before it can be researched.
- Fixed a bug which allowed players to skate on Frozen Water without Skates.
- Fixed a bug which caused medium or high snow to affect the Skate action.
- Being tired no longer hides the Southern Rapids dive into Green Falls action.
- Boiling durability is now hidden if its 0.
- Pond now has proper Winter art.
- Cutting down large trees now costs a bit more stamina.
- Pyre now burns through its fuel faster than before.
- Fixed a bug where saving and loading a game while having items in inventory blueprints such as Crucible would move items between slots or mess with their durabiities and type.
- Sledges can now be repaired using twine.
- Fixed a bug which prevented Springberries and Billberries from being placeable in Unsealed Fermentation Bin.
- Removed the Partridge Enchantment Blueprint from Duck Carcass.

- It is no longer possible to move items and liquids in and out of sealed Fermentation bins.
- Animals now get tired a bit faster when running away from the player.
- Frost Shrine now melts on temperatures above 0.
- Removed enchantment recipe from skinned squirrels.
- Fixed a bug which prevented metal skinning knife from being used in blueprints requiring a cutting tool.
- Fixed the art for Hare Urge.
- Fixed a glitch where a rustic barrel would permanently stay heated up.
- Dry needles are now considered bedding material and improvised bed can be made from them.
- Campfire, Rain, Frostleaf and Garlic now offer some mosquito protection.
- Fixed some typos and incorrect texts.
- Added description for Cattail Fluff.
- Ongoing saves which started outside of River Clearing should no longer get stuck when you enter River Clearing.
- Infection statuses are now visible and pinable inside the Internal Status Page.
- Rustic Barrels can no longer hold liquids and solids at the same time.
- Fixed a bug where the will o' wisp even would appear when you entered the river clearing if you had started from a different location. 
- Mortar and Pestle can now crush edible acorns into flour.
- Fixed a bug that was causing the death of bears to affect other animals.
- Fixed a bug that was causing the animals (including the bear) not to die properly when poisoned.
- Fixed a bug that was causing the wolf to be too aggressive.
- Nesting Box can now be picked up and placed down. (if your partridge are not laying eggs, trying picking the box up and placing it again)
- New areas now have proper icons for the Parchment Map.
- Fixed a bug where carcasses would get eaten by wolves from the player's hands.
- Ducks and Partridges eaten by predators no longer drop hooks and needles but bone pieces instead.
- Hardtack now lasts a lot longer before spoiling
- Intermediate hunting now unlocks when both basic hunting and basic survival are completed.
- Dried nettle leaves now have a trade value.
- Fixed the weight of unfired storage pot and cauldron.
- Frost Shrine Blueprint now properly spends the water used.
- Fixed an issue where animals couldn't be attacked.
- Fixed a bug which caused nightvision to persist after moon blessing.
- Warming up by the Furnace no longer triggers fire spirit Summoning.
- Updated Chinese translation.
- Fixed duplicate texts in Chinese, Korean and Japanese.
- Hopefully fixed an issue with starting older save files on modded version of the games.
- Wolves will now get angry if you spend too much time in an area with them.
- Added starting resources to new starting locations.
- Sharpened stone can now be made in the Dark.
- Squirrel Carcass can no longer be eaten or cooked it needs to be butchered first.
- Fixed a bug which allowed the player to butcher the piglet carcass more than once.
- Fixed a combat window bug that would get the game stuck.



That's all for now.
See you all in 2026!

Reminder: All fixes and new content are added to the public beta branch first.
If you want to access them you can find the instructions on the link below. Be warned though, things are less stable there and are likely to undergo balance changes quite frequently! :)

contents.ja:
免責事項：このお知らせは機械翻訳を使用して翻訳されています。一部の用語に誤りがある場合はご容赦ください。

皆さん、こんにちは！
新しいアップデートのお知らせです。

まず、本日は新しい動物システムを導入する前に、メインブランチを最新バージョンにアップデートしました。新しいシステムは、より安定しバランスが取れた段階で、後ほど統合する予定です。

これはホリデーシーズン前の最後のアップデートとなりますので、皆様にメリークリスマスと良いお年をお迎えください！ :)

それでは、新しいコンテンツについて：

<size=150%>動物の改善：</size>動物には多くの改善を加えており、今後もさらに改善を予定しています。今後数週間かけて、これらの新機能の調整を行っていきます。ご意見やバグの発見がありましたら、ぜひお知らせください！ :)

<size=125%>ナビゲーション:</size>動物はついに魔法で崖を登れなくなりました。逃げる時でさえ登れません！

<size=125%>罠:</size>動物NPCには、以前の罠システムは適用されなくなりました。動物は罠に自力で反応するようになり、罠の種類、プレイヤーの罠スキル、そして自身の狡猾さに応じて罠を作動させる可能性があります。また、オオカミの群れも再び罠に反応し、仲間のオオカミの一部を奪われることがあります。

<size=125%>食料:</size>動物は空腹であれば地面から食料を食べられるようになりました。そのため、地面に物を置かないように注意してください。
ノウサギやシカのような臆病な動物は、よほど空腹でない限り地面を避けますが、オオカミ、クマ、イノシシのような攻撃的な動物は、プレイヤーの存在を気にしないことが多いです。彼らはあなたがそこにいる間は食べ物を食べませんが、あなたが立ち去らないと次第に怒りを募らせていきます。

<size=125%>匂い：</size>一部の動物は嗅覚が鋭く、遠くからでも食べ物を感知できます。これは問題となることもありますが、逆に有利に利用することもできます。現時点では、これは肉などの匂いの強い食べ物にのみ有効で、野菜には効果がありません。イノシシとクマは特に嗅覚が鋭く、クマはインベントリを開けて中の食べ物を食べることもあるため、特に危険です。

<size=125%>作物：</size>一部の動物は庭や畑の植物を食べ、植物に被害を与えるようになりました。
イノシシは作物にとって非常に危険なので、対策を講じましょう。現時点では、イノシシ対策の最善策は、家の近くに作物を植えてイノシシが近づいてくる音を聞き、被害が出る前に攻撃することです。あるいは、イノシシが罠を仕掛けて餌にし、うまくいけば殺されるのを期待するのも良いでしょう。

<size=150%>農業改善：</size>
<size=125%>堤防：</size>この新しい土地改善は建設が難しいですが、洪水から地域を守り、長期的な居住に適した環境を作ります。時間の経過とともに徐々に劣化するため、ある程度のメンテナンスも必要です。

<size=125%>小麦：</size>商人から購入できる新しい穀物です。ライ麦よりもはるかに繊細で、多くの栄養素を必要としますが、成長が早く、より美味しいです。
春に肥沃な土壌に植えると、最も多くの収穫が得られます。
もちろん、その穀物はパン製品全般、エール、シロップの製造にも使えます。

<size=125%>脱穀機：</size>ライ麦と小麦の脱穀作業を高速化する、比較的シンプルな新しい道具です。

<size=125%>鎌：</size>植物をより速く収穫できる新しい金属製の道具です。

<size=125%>大鎌：</size>植物をより速く、より効率的に収穫できる、もう一つの新しい金属製の道具です（スタミナ消費量が少ない）。ただし、この道具は畑でのみ使用でき、庭では使用できません。

<size=125%>金属の鍬：</size>フリント鍬と同じですが、耐久性が大幅に向上しています。

<size=125%>畑の改良：</size>畑の収穫量が2倍になりましたが、収穫手順も2倍になりました。

<size=125%>ガーデンの改良：</size>ガーデン区画の酸度と栄養分の減少速度が大幅に向上し、維持管理が容易になりました。
肥料の栄養分添加量が半分になり、より実用的で使いやすくなりました。また、排泄物や腐葉土を堆肥箱に入れると、肥料の価値が2倍になったため、肥料作りも容易になりました。
さらに、ガーデンに土壌を「リセット」できる特別なアクションが追加されました。土壌の栄養分、酸度、水分量を初期値に戻しますが、植物にはダメージを与えます。

今回のアップデートの主な新機能は以上です。
パッチノートはこちらです。

<size=150%>バージョン EA_0.56 と前回のパッチノート以降のホットフィックス：</size>
- トラップが動物NPCに作用するようになりました。
- 動物が食料アイテムを食べられるようになりました。
- 動物が作物とインタラクトできるようになりました。
- クマがインベントリとインタラクトできるようになりました。
- 新しい農具（脱穀機、鎌、大鎌、金属の鍬）を追加しました。
- 堤防の改良を追加しました。
- 庭の区画と畑のバランス調整を行いました。
- 小麦とその派生品を追加しました。
- 一部の家具と改良品の聖域価値を調整しました。
- 旬のベリーがある地域にクマがより頻繁に訪れるようになりました。
- 動物の出現率を遅くしました。
- 狩猟用の槍を研究するには、金属の槍が必要になりました。
- プレイヤーがスケートをできるバグを修正しました。凍った水の上（スケートなしで）
- 中程度または高い積雪がスケートの行動に影響を与えるバグを修正しました。
- 疲労しても、Southern Rapids から Green Falls へのダイブアクションが隠れなくなりました。
- 沸騰の耐久度が 0 の場合、表示されなくなりました。
- 池に適切な冬のグラフィックが追加されました。
- 大きな木を伐採する際のスタミナ消費量が少し増加しました。
- Pyre の燃料消費が以前より早くなりました。
- Crucible などのインベントリ設計図にアイテムがある状態でゲームをセーブ/ロードすると、アイテムがスロット間で移動したり、耐久度や種類が変わってしまうバグを修正しました。
- ソリが麻ひもを使って修理できるようになりました。
- Springberries と Billberries を未封印の発酵槽に置けないバグを修正しました。
- Duck Carcass から Partridge エンチャント設計図を削除しました。

- 封印された発酵槽にアイテムや液体を出し入れできなくなりました。
- 動物がプレイヤーから逃げる際に、少し早く疲れるようになりました。
- 霜の祠は気温が0度を超えると溶けるようになりました。
- 皮を剥いだリスのエンチャントレシピを削除しました。
- 切削工具を必要とする設計図で、金属製の皮剥ぎナイフが使用できないバグを修正しました。
- 野ウサギの衝動のアートを修正しました。
- 素朴な樽が常に熱くなってしまう不具合を修正しました。
- 乾燥した針葉樹が寝具として扱われるようになり、即席のベッドを作ることができるようになりました。
- キャンプファイヤー、雨、霜の葉、ニンニクが蚊よけ効果を持つようになりました。
- いくつかの誤字と誤ったテキストを修正しました。
- ガマの綿毛の説明を追加しました。
- 川の空き地の外で開始された進行中のセーブは、川の空き地に入った際に停止しなくなりました。
- 感染ステータスが内部ステータスページで表示およびピン留めできるようになりました。
- 素朴な樽に液体と固体を同時に入れることができなくなりました。
- 別の場所から川の空き地に入った際にウィル・オ・ウィスプが出現するバグを修正しました。
